pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Where should you start mopping? (1 mark)
   A. Next to the door
   B. Outside
   C. In the middle
   D. At the corner farthest from the door

2. Why do we dust from high places to low places? (1 mark)
   A. Low places are dirtier
   B. Dust falls downward
   C. It looks better
   D. High places are easier

3. Why should a rubbish bin have a lid? (1 mark)
   A. To make it heavy
   B. To keep out flies and rats
   C. To look pretty
   D. To stop rubbish from rotting

4. What should you do after cleaning the house? (1 mark)
   A. Eat without washing
   B. Play in the dirt
   C. Touch food
   D. Wash hands with soap

5. Which method removes dry dirt from the floor with a broom? (1 mark)
   A. Washing
   B. Mopping
   C. Sweeping
   D. Dusting

6. How can a dustpan be improvised? (1 mark)
   A. Use a rope
   B. Use a sack
   C. Cut a jerrican or flat tin
   D. Use a chair

7. Which PPE protects the feet from mud and water? (1 mark)
   A. Dust mask
   B. Gloves
   C. Gumboots
   D. Headgear

8. What is the use of labelling PPE? (1 mark)
   A. To make it heavier
   B. To tear it
   C. To hide it
   D. So each item goes back to its owner

9. Where should canvas shoes be dried? (1 mark)
   A. Under wet clothes
   B. In a fire
   C. In an airy, shady place
   D. In a sealed box

10. Why should PPE be cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. To make it smell
   B. Clean PPE is heavier
   C. Dirty PPE lasts longer
   D. Dirty PPE can carry germs

11. What should you do with tacking when permanent sewing is done? (1 mark)
   A. Wash it
   B. Dye it
   C. Leave it for ever
   D. Cut and pull it out

12. Which is a type of tacking stitch? (1 mark)
   A. Chain stitch
   B. Even tacking
   C. Cross stitch
   D. Satin stitch

13. Why do we knot the end of the thread? (1 mark)
   A. To make it longer
   B. So it does not pull through the cloth
   C. To colour it
   D. To make it stronger

14. What should you do if you prick your finger? (1 mark)
   A. Tell the teacher and wash with soap and water
   B. Ignore it
   C. Hide it
   D. Put dirt on it

15. What should you never do with a needle? (1 mark)
   A. Put it in your mouth
   B. Keep it in a pin cushion
   C. Thread it
   D. Use a thimble

16. In long and short tacking, the pattern is (1 mark)
   A. All gaps long
   B. All stitches short
   C. No stitch
   D. A long stitch followed by a short stitch

17. In even tacking, the stitches and gaps are (1 mark)
   A. Very long
   B. The same length
   C. Absent
   D. Different lengths

18. What is one purpose of tacking? (1 mark)
   A. To cut cloth
   B. To iron cloth
   C. To wash cloth
   D. To hold layers of cloth together before sewing

19. What do you use to mark a straight line on cloth? (1 mark)
   A. Chalk and a ruler
   B. A broom
   C. A plate
   D. A hammer

20. What is a hem? (1 mark)
   A. A button
   B. A folded and stitched edge of cloth
   C. A needle
   D. A hole

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Why is tacking better than pins alone? (2 marks)

22. Choose PPE for gardening and say why. (3 marks)

23. Describe how to make even tacking. (4 marks)

24. What are tacking stitches? (2 marks)

25. Explain three safety rules when cleaning. (3 marks)

26. Why should gumboots not be dried near a hot fire? (2 marks)

27. Describe how to mop a floor. (4 marks)

28. Give three ways of disposing of refuse safely. (3 marks)

29. Explain how measuring skills help you in tacking. (3 marks)

30. What should be done with a paper dust mask that is dirty? (2 marks)

31. Why should plastic not be burnt? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — At the corner farthest from the door
   You do not step on the clean floor.

2. B — Dust falls downward
   Dust moves downward.

3. B — To keep out flies and rats
   Lids stop pests.

4. D — Wash hands with soap
   Hands may carry germs.

5. C — Sweeping
   Sweeping uses a broom.

6. C — Cut a jerrican or flat tin
   A cut jerrican forms a scoop.

7. C — Gumboots
   Gumboots are waterproof.

8. D — So each item goes back to its owner
   Labels avoid mix-ups.

9. C — In an airy, shady place
   Gentle drying protects the shoes.

10. D — Dirty PPE can carry germs
   Clean PPE is safe and lasts longer.

11. D — Cut and pull it out
   Tacking is temporary.

12. B — Even tacking
   Even tacking is taught in Grade 4.

13. B — So it does not pull through the cloth
   A knot anchors the thread.

14. A — Tell the teacher and wash with soap and water
   Clean the wound.

15. A — Put it in your mouth
   Needles are dangerous in the mouth.

16. D — A long stitch followed by a short stitch
   The pattern alternates.

17. B — The same length
   Even tacking is equal.

18. D — To hold layers of cloth together before sewing
   Tacking keeps layers in place.

19. A — Chalk and a ruler
   Chalk marks show the line.

20. B — A folded and stitched edge of cloth
   A hem stops edges fraying.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Pins can slip or prick, tacking holds cloth firmly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Gloves protect hands from dirt and cuts; gumboots protect feet from mud; hat protects the head from the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item with reason.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mark a line; bring the needle up; make 1 cm stitches with 1 cm gaps along the line; keep the thread loose; finish with a small back stitch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four steps.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Large, loose temporary stitches used to hold cloth in place before permanent sewing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for temporary, 1 mark for holding cloth.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not mix chemicals; keep chemicals from children; wear gloves for dirty work; do not leave floors wet (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Heat can crack the rubber and spoil the boots.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for heat, 1 mark for cracking.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sweep first; fill a bucket with clean soapy water; squeeze the mop; start from the far corner and mop backwards to the door; rinse the mop; leave the floor to dry with a warning.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four steps.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Compost organic waste; put other waste in a bin with a lid and take it to a collection point; reuse or recycle paper, plastic and glass; wrap broken glass.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Measuring gives correct stitch lengths, straight lines and correct size of the item.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is thrown away and replaced, not washed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for throwing, 1 mark for replacing.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: The smoke is harmful to health and the environment.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for harmful smoke, 1 mark for the environment or health.
